title: Issues with 1.1.1.1 public resolver in Canada

timeline.body: Cloudflare is aware of, and investigating, an issue which potentially impacts multiple users in Canada that use 1.1.1.1 public resolver. Further detail will be provided as more information becomes available.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: We have reached out to the network where we see an active hijack of 1.1.1.0/24. 1.0.0.1 and public resolver IPv6 prefixes are fully operational and reachable at this time.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: The network with the offending route leak has fixed the issue on their end. We are currently monitoring the effect of this fix.
timeline.label: monitoring
